boundary: No transaction: PreviewServlet.doGet resolves the weblog and the preview page/template, each read through JPAPersistenceStrategy.getEntityManager(false) auto-committing individually; rendering (renderer.render, PreviewServlet.java:219) then runs the selected Velocity template, which can pull further reads through the loaded PreviewPageModel.

ops_add.note: If the default/weblog theme template is the one selected for preview, it calls '#set($pager = $model.getWeblogEntriesPager())' (themes/basic/weblog.vm:24); PreviewPageModel.getWeblogEntriesPager(String) (PreviewPageModel.java:97-128) falls back to WeblogEntriesLatestPager when no preview-entry anchor is set, whose constructor (WeblogEntriesLatestPager.java:65) calls getEntries() -> JPAWeblogEntryManagerImpl.getWeblogEntryObjectMap (:84) -> getWeblogEntries (JPAWeblogEntryManagerImpl.java:849), a dynamic JPQL query against WeblogEntry (table weblogentry). Which template PreviewServlet.doGet actually selects (PreviewServlet.java:97-144, page/tags/permalink/default) was not individually traced for this entry point, so this is conditional and only one of several possible template-driven paths.

notes: ModelLoader.loadModels (PreviewServlet.java:180,185) dispatches to Model.init for PreviewPageModel/ConfigModel/UtilitiesModel/PreviewURLModel/MessageModel/CalendarModel/MenuModel (plus SiteModel/PlanetModel for the site-wide weblog). Only the PageModel-derived entries pager was checked against the 'basic' theme's default weblog.vm; other preview page selections (permalink, tags index, css, custom page) were not traced, so confidence is medium.
